cohort: The study included three neonates born prematurely, weighing less than 2 kg, with severe congenital diaphragmatic hernia and normal fetal karyotypes, who received ECMO despite traditionally being ineligible.
finding: All three low birth weight and premature infants with severe congenital diaphragmatic hernia who received ECMO survived to 2 years of age, were making developmental progress, and experienced no short- or long-term complications directly attributable to ECMO support.
